The Hanshin JF... Vodka managed to muscle 
her way over the high hurdle that is a GⅠ 
race.

After the race, I talk with Vodka about 
what comes next. If we're aiming for the 
Japan Derby, the Classic Triple Crown 
route is the orthodox path, but...

Provoked by Daiwa Scarlet, Vodka reacts in 
kind... Breaking from conventional wisdom, 
she sets her sights on the Tulip Sho.
